NOT KILLABLE HERE, AND THE REASON, so its absence is not read as an
oversight.
`unsigned char flags = dcr->flags;` at the top of dcr_process, used
everywhere below instead of re-reading the field.
The object re-reads `dcr->flags` after the printf (0x2f6 `movzbl
(%ebx),%ecx`), which a cached local would not need, so the source reads
the field at each use site.  Nothing in `t_dcr.c` can hold that: the
only call in the function is `dsplibs_debug_printf`, and the harness's
printf does not write the object, so the cached and re-read forms agree
on every observable -- verdict, buffer, all 32 bytes, transcript -- for
every input there is.  It would be caught by a caller that mutated its
own flags from inside the logger, and no such caller exists.
